title: Smoky Namul Stir Fry
description: A spicy and savory Chinese-inspired stir fry made with namul, adventurous black beans, and smoky flavors.
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add smoky and korean chili flakes; stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add namul and adventurous black beans; stir-fry for 3-4 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce and brown sugar.
Pour the soy sauce mixture over the namul mixture; stir-fry for an additional 2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
Garnish with green onions and sesame seeds, if desired.
